an5.170:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an5.170:1.2: atha kho āyasmā bhaddaji yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an5.170:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ bhaddajiṃ āyasmā ānando etadavoca:
an5.170:1.4: kinnu kho āvuso bhaddaji, dassanānaṃ aggaṃ? kiṃ savaṇānaṃ aggaṃ? kiṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ? kiṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ? kiṃ bhavānaṃ agganti?
an5.170:2.1: atthāvuso, brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu daso vasavattī, yo taṃ brahmānaṃ passati, idaṃ dassanānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:2.2: atthāvuso ābhassarā nāma devā sukhena abhisannā parisannā.
an5.170:2.5: yo taṃ saddaṃ suṇāti, idaṃ savaṇānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:2.7: te santaññeva sukhitā sukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti. idaṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:2.8: atthāvuso, ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā devā. idaṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:2.9: atthāvuso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagā devā. idaṃ bhavānaṃ agganti.
an5.170:2.10: sameti kho idaṃ āyasmato bhaddajissa yadidaṃ bahujanenāti.
an5.170:3.3: tena hi āvuso, bhaddaji, suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmīti.
an5.170:3.4: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā bhaddaji āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
an5.170:4.1: yathā passato kho āvuso, anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ dassanānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:4.2: yathā suṇato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ savaṇānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:4.3: yathā sukhitassa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti. idaṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:4.4: yathā saññissa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:4.5: yathābhūtassa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ bhavānaṃ agganti.
